claim: Palette 4 turns tiles that hold colour green (109, 304, 454, 146, 1665, 1717) but leaves greys grey (374 stays white); on 300 and 301 it reads as camouflage and as a floor's light it reads as moss.
evidence: tried and judged in Gravesend's Phantom Terminus, 2026-11-24 (projects/blood-city/references/phantom-terminus-design.md)
use: Look at a tile under a palette before relying on it for a colour; a sick green light is better on coloured surfaces than on floors.
